fetchProductData.description: The `fetchProductData` function fetches product data for a given SKU. It can fetch either simple product data or refined product data with selected options.

sku.description: The SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) of the product to fetch.

options.description: Optional configuration including `anchors` (anchor options), `optionsUIDs` (selected option IDs), `preselectFirstOption` (whether to preselect first option), `isBundle` (whether product is a bundle), and `skipTransform` (whether to skip data transformation).

getFetchedProductData.description: The `getFetchedProductData` function returns previously fetched product data from cache.

options.description: Optional configuration for retrieving cached product data.

getProductConfigurationValues.description: The `getProductConfigurationValues` function returns the current product configuration values.

options.description: Optional configuration for retrieving product configuration values.

getProductData.description: The `getProductData` function returns the product data for a given product SKU. It fetches data from Adobe Commerce and optionally preselects the first available option. The function calls the [`products`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql-api/index.html#query-products) query.

sku.description: The SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) of the product to fetch.

preselectFirstOption.description: Whether to automatically preselect the first available option for configurable products.

optionsUIDs.description: An array of option UIDs to preselect for the product.

raw.description: Whether to return raw GraphQL data without transformation.

getRefinedProduct.description: The `getRefinedProduct` function returns refined product data with specific options selected. This is used for configurable products where options have been chosen. The function calls the [`refineProduct`](https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/graphql-api/index.html#query-refineProduct) query.

sku.description: The SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) of the product to fetch.

optionUIDs.description: An array of option UIDs representing the selected variant.

anchorOptions.description: Anchor options for the product selection.

raw.description: Whether to return raw GraphQL data without transformation.

isProductConfigurationValid.description: The `isProductConfigurationValid` function checks if the current product configuration is valid.

setProductConfigurationValid.description: The `setProductConfigurationValid` function sets a callback to be called when product configuration validity changes.

callback.description: A callback function that receives the validity status of the product configuration.

setProductConfigurationValues.description: The `setProductConfigurationValues` function sets a callback to be called when product configuration values change.

callback.description: A callback function that receives the updated product configuration values.
